A request carrying an explicit lowercase `host` header is rendered with both

"""Reduced reproduction of HTTPie bug 4 at 8c892edd."""


class CaseInsensitiveHeaders:
    def __init__(self, values: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        self._values = values

    def items(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        return list(self._values)

    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
        return any(key.casefold() == name.casefold() for key, _value in self._values)


def rendered_headers(original: CaseInsensitiveHeaders, url_host: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    headers = dict(original.items())
    if "Host" not in headers:
        headers["Host"] = url_host
    return headers

An HTTP bearer dependency configured with `auto_error=False` correctly returns
no credentials when the header is absent, but still raises 403 when the header

"""Reduced reproduction of FastAPI bug 12 at d61f5e4b."""


class AuthenticationError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class HTTPBearer:
    def __init__(self, auto_error: bool = True) -> None:
        self.auto_error = auto_error

    def authenticate(self, authorization: str | None) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
        if not authorization:
            if self.auto_error:
                raise AuthenticationError("Not authenticated")
            return None
        scheme, credentials = authorization.split(" ", 1)
        if scheme.casefold() != "bearer":
            raise AuthenticationError("Invalid authentication credentials")
        return scheme, credentials

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class APIRoute:
    path: str
    name: str


@dataclass
class WebSocketRoute:
    path: str
    name: str


class APIRouter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.routes: list[APIRoute | WebSocketRoute] = []

    def include_router(self, child: APIRouter, prefix: str) -> None:
